title: Valle Chispa
author: TechOli652854
selftext:
I've created a game using Generative AI (Codex), inspired by clicker games! 🎮

The game has a pixel art style, and I've created several pixel art pets, different gems (which you can click on), animations, and more!

The best thing about Generative AI is that it allows people like me, who don't know how to code but have lots of ideas, to bring those ideas to life.

I hope you enjoy the game, and I'd love to hear your feedback! 💚

The game runs directly in your browser and is completely open-source. You can check out the code on GitHub:

🔗 [https://github.com/26-oliver/Valle-Chispa](https://github.com/26-oliver/Valle-Chispa)

Game link: [https://26-oliver.github.io/Valle-Chispa/](https://26-oliver.github.io/Valle-Chispa/)
